sentences.fr: J’ai envoyé le rapport à ma collègue hier soir.
sentences.en: I sent the report to my colleague last night.
distractors: I sent the report to my boss last night.
I sent the report to my colleague this morning.

sentences.fr: Notre réunion de lundi matin est annulée.
sentences.en: Our Monday morning meeting is cancelled.
distractors: Our Tuesday morning meeting is cancelled.
Our Monday evening meeting is cancelled.

sentences.fr: Est-ce que tu as fini ton exercice de grammaire ?
sentences.en: Have you finished your grammar exercise?
distractors: Have you started your grammar exercise?
Has he finished his grammar exercise?

sentences.fr: Je me lève à six heures pour arriver au bureau tôt.
sentences.en: I get up at six to get to the office early.
distractors: I get up at seven to get to the office early.
I get up at six to leave the office early.

sentences.fr: Mon patron ne répond jamais à ses courriels le week-end.
sentences.en: My boss never answers his emails at the weekend.
distractors: My boss always answers his emails at the weekend.
My boss never answers his emails during the week.

sentences.fr: Quand j’étais étudiant, je travaillais dans une boulangerie.
sentences.en: When I was a student, I worked in a bakery.
distractors: When I was a student, I worked in a bookshop.
When I was a teacher, I worked in a bakery.

sentences.fr: Elle a réussi son examen de mathématiques avec une bonne note.
sentences.en: She passed her maths exam with a good grade.
distractors: He passed his maths exam with a good grade.
She passed her history exam with a good grade.

sentences.fr: Nous avons commencé le projet la semaine dernière.
sentences.en: We started the project last week.
distractors: We started the project last month.
We finished the project last week.

sentences.fr: Le cours de français commence à neuf heures et demie.
sentences.en: The French class starts at half past nine.
distractors: The French class starts at half past ten.
The French class ends at half past nine.

sentences.fr: Je n’ai pas encore reçu ta réponse.
sentences.en: I haven't received your reply yet.
distractors: I have already received your reply.
I haven't received his reply yet.

sentences.fr: Je ne trouve pas ce mot dans le dictionnaire.
sentences.en: I can't find this word in the dictionary.
distractors: I can't find this sentence in the dictionary.
I can find this word in the dictionary.

sentences.fr: Ma sœur est ingénieure dans une grande entreprise allemande.
sentences.en: My sister is an engineer at a big German company.
distractors: My brother is an engineer at a big German company.
My sister is an engineer at a small German company.

sentences.fr: Il faut rendre le devoir avant vendredi midi.
sentences.en: The homework has to be handed in before Friday noon.
distractors: The homework has to be handed in before Monday noon.
The homework has to be handed in before Friday evening.

gloss.en: to hand in; to give back

sentences.fr: Vous pouvez répéter la question, s’il vous plaît ?
sentences.en: Could you repeat the question, please?
distractors: Could you repeat the answer, please?
Could you write the question, please?

sentences.fr: On se réunit tous les mardis à dix heures.
sentences.en: We meet every Tuesday at ten.
distractors: We meet every Thursday at ten.
We meet every Tuesday at nine.

sentences.fr: J’ai oublié mon mot de passe, alors je n’ai pas pu ouvrir le fichier.
sentences.en: I forgot my password, so I couldn't open the file.
distractors: I forgot my password, so I couldn't send the file.
I forgot my password, so I couldn't find the file.

sentences.fr: Le professeur nous a expliqué la leçon deux fois.
sentences.en: The teacher explained the lesson to us twice.
distractors: The teacher explained the lesson to us once.
The teacher explained the exercise to us twice.

sentences.fr: Je lui ai envoyé un message, mais il ne m’a pas répondu.
sentences.en: I sent him a message, but he didn't answer me.
distractors: He sent me a message, but I didn't answer him.
I sent him a message, but he answered me.

sentences.fr: Mon collègue est arrivé en retard à la réunion.
sentences.en: My colleague arrived late to the meeting.
distractors: My colleague arrived early to the meeting.
My colleague arrived late to the class.

sentences.fr: Elle travaille comme serveuse le soir pour payer ses études.
sentences.en: She works as a waitress in the evening to pay for her studies.
distractors: She works as a waitress in the morning to pay for her studies.
He works as a waiter in the evening to pay for his studies.

sentences.fr: Je passerai mon examen de français en juin.
sentences.en: I will take my French exam in June.
distractors: I will take my French exam in July.
I took my French exam in June.

sentences.fr: L’entretien d’embauche se passera par téléphone.
sentences.en: The job interview will take place over the phone.
distractors: The job interview took place over the phone.
The job interview will take place at the office.

sentences.fr: Ce logiciel est plus rapide que l’ancien.
sentences.en: This software is faster than the old one.
distractors: This software is slower than the old one.
This software is faster than the new one.

sentences.fr: Il n’y a plus de papier pour l’imprimante.
sentences.en: There's no more paper for the printer.
distractors: There's still paper for the printer.
There's no more paper for the computer.

sentences.fr: Vous devez signer le contrat avant la fin du mois.
sentences.en: You have to sign the contract before the end of the month.
distractors: You have to sign the contract before the end of the week.
You have to read the contract before the end of the month.

sentences.fr: Quand est-ce que tu commences ton stage ?
sentences.en: When do you start your internship?
distractors: Where do you start your internship?
When do you finish your internship?

sentences.fr: Il y avait trop de bruit, alors je n’ai rien entendu.
sentences.en: There was too much noise, so I didn't hear anything.
distractors: There was too much noise, so I didn't say anything.
There was too much noise, so I didn't understand anything.

sentences.fr: Nous avons besoin d’un nouvel ordinateur au bureau.
sentences.en: We need a new computer at the office.
distractors: We need a new printer at the office.
They need a new computer at the office.

sentences.fr: Cette semaine, les cours commencent à huit heures.
sentences.en: This week, classes start at eight.
distractors: This week, classes start at nine.
Next week, classes start at eight.

sentences.fr: Tu as bien travaillé ce trimestre !
sentences.en: You worked well this term!
distractors: You worked well last term!
You didn't work well this term!

sentences.fr: Mon frère cherche un emploi depuis trois mois.
sentences.en: My brother has been looking for a job for three months.
distractors: My sister has been looking for a job for three months.
My brother has been looking for a job for three weeks.

sentences.fr: Est-ce qu’il y a une imprimante à cet étage ?
sentences.en: Is there a printer on this floor?
distractors: Is there a computer on this floor?
Is there a printer on the next floor?

sentences.fr: Elle est devenue avocate après cinq ans d’études.
sentences.en: She became a lawyer after five years of study.
distractors: She became a doctor after five years of study.
She became a lawyer after four years of study.

sentences.fr: Je dois finir ce dossier avant de partir.
sentences.en: I have to finish this file before I leave.
distractors: I have to start this file before I leave.
He has to finish this file before he leaves.

sentences.fr: Nous nous sommes rencontrés pendant une formation à Lyon.
sentences.en: We met during a training course in Lyon.
distractors: We met during a meeting in Lyon.
We met during a training course in Lille.

sentences.fr: Le directeur veut nous voir dans son bureau à quatorze heures.
sentences.en: The director wants to see us in his office at 2 p.m.
distractors: The director wants to see us in his office at 4 p.m.
The director wants to see you in his office at 2 p.m.

sentences.fr: Je préfère lire les articles en français le matin.
sentences.en: I prefer to read articles in French in the morning.
distractors: I prefer to write articles in French in the morning.
I prefer to read articles in French in the evening.

sentences.fr: Nous n’avons pas encore choisi la date de la réunion.
sentences.en: We haven't chosen the date of the meeting yet.
distractors: We have already chosen the date of the meeting.
They haven't chosen the date of the meeting yet.

sentences.fr: Si tu as une question, écris-moi un courriel.
sentences.en: If you have a question, write me an email.
distractors: If you have a question, call me.
If you have a problem, write me an email.

sentences.fr: Elle a travaillé toute la nuit sur sa présentation.
sentences.en: She worked all night on her presentation.
distractors: She worked all morning on her presentation.
He worked all night on his presentation.

sentences.fr: Les étudiants écoutent le professeur sans parler.
sentences.en: The students listen to the teacher without talking.
distractors: The teachers listen to the student without talking.
The students listen to the teacher and talk.

sentences.fr: Mon ordinateur est tombé en panne pendant la réunion.
sentences.en: My computer broke down during the meeting.
distractors: My printer broke down during the meeting.
My computer broke down after the meeting.

sentences.fr: Je vais changer de travail l’année prochaine.
sentences.en: I'm going to change jobs next year.
distractors: I'm going to change jobs next month.
I want to change jobs next year.

sentences.fr: Combien d’heures est-ce que tu travailles par semaine ?
sentences.en: How many hours a week do you work?
distractors: How many days a week do you work?
How many hours a week does she work?

sentences.fr: Il a perdu son emploi, mais il a trouvé une formation intéressante.
sentences.en: He lost his job, but he found an interesting training course.
distractors: She lost her job, but she found an interesting training course.
He left his job, but he found an interesting training course.

sentences.fr: Cet exercice est moins difficile que le dernier.
sentences.en: This exercise is less difficult than the last one.
distractors: This exercise is more difficult than the last one.
This lesson is less difficult than the last one.

sentences.fr: Le professeur m’a conseillé de lire ce livre.
sentences.en: The teacher advised me to read this book.
distractors: The teacher advised me to buy this book.
The teacher advised us to read this book.

sentences.fr: Nous avons reçu quinze candidatures pour ce poste.
sentences.en: We received fifteen applications for this position.
distractors: We received fifty applications for this position.
We sent fifteen applications for this position.

sentences.fr: Quand je suis arrivé au bureau, mes collègues travaillaient déjà.
sentences.en: When I got to the office, my colleagues were already working.
distractors: When I got to the office, my colleagues weren't working yet.
When I left the office, my colleagues were already working.

sentences.fr: Ne réponds pas à ce courriel tout de suite.
sentences.en: Don't answer this email right away.
distractors: Answer this email right away.
Don't send this email right away.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Salut Marc, tu es libre jeudi matin ?
lines.en: Hi Marc, are you free on Thursday morning?

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Jeudi matin, j’ai un rendez-vous chez le dentiste. Et vendredi ?
lines.en: Thursday morning I have an appointment at the dentist's. What about Friday?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Vendredi, je suis en formation toute la journée.
lines.en: On Friday I'm on a training course all day.

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Alors on se voit lundi prochain à dix heures ?
lines.en: So we'll see each other next Monday at ten?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Parfait. Je réserve la petite salle et j’envoie un message à l’équipe.
lines.en: Perfect. I'll book the small room and send the team a message.

questions.question: Why can't Marc meet on Thursday morning?
choices: He is on a training course all day.
He is not in the office that week.
questions.explanation: Marc says “j’ai un rendez-vous chez le dentiste”.

questions.question: What is Camille doing on Friday?
questions.explanation: She says “je suis en formation toute la journée”.

questions.question: When will the two of them finally meet?
questions.explanation: Marc proposes “lundi prochain à dix heures” and Camille answers “Parfait”.

questions.question: What does Camille say she will do?
choices: Book the small room and message the team.
questions.explanation: “Je réserve la petite salle et j’envoie un message à l’équipe.”

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Madame, est-ce que l’examen de mardi porte sur tout le chapitre ?
lines.en: Ma'am, is Tuesday's exam on the whole chapter?

lines.speaker: La professeure
lines.fr: Non, seulement sur les trois premières leçons.
lines.en: No, only on the first three lessons.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: On a le droit d’utiliser le dictionnaire ?
lines.en: Are we allowed to use the dictionary?

lines.speaker: La professeure
lines.fr: Oui, mais pas le téléphone. L’examen dure une heure et demie.
lines.en: Yes, but not the phone. The exam lasts an hour and a half.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Merci, je vais réviser ce week-end.
lines.en: Thanks, I'm going to study this weekend.

questions.question: What does the exam cover?
questions.explanation: The teacher says “seulement sur les trois premières leçons”.

questions.question: What are the students allowed to use?
questions.explanation: “On a le droit d’utiliser le dictionnaire ?” — “Oui, mais pas le téléphone.”

questions.question: How long does the exam last?
questions.explanation: “L’examen dure une heure et demie.”

questions.question: When is Julien going to study?
questions.explanation: “je vais réviser ce week-end”.

gloss.en: to revise; to study for an exam

lines.speaker: Mme Roux
lines.fr: Vous avez déjà travaillé dans une grande entreprise ?
lines.en: Have you already worked in a big company?

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.fr: Oui, j’ai passé deux ans dans une entreprise de transport à Lille.
lines.en: Yes, I spent two years in a transport company in Lille.

lines.speaker: Mme Roux
lines.fr: Pourquoi est-ce que vous voulez changer ?
lines.en: Why do you want to change?

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.fr: Je cherche un poste avec plus de responsabilités.
lines.en: I'm looking for a position with more responsibility.

lines.speaker: Mme Roux
lines.fr: Le contrat commence le premier septembre. Ça vous convient ?
lines.en: The contract starts on the first of September. Does that suit you?

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.fr: Oui, mais je dois d’abord finir un projet chez mon employeur actuel.
lines.en: Yes, but first I have to finish a project at my current employer's.

questions.question: Where did Thomas work before?
choices: In a big company in Paris.
In a transport company in Lille.
In a transport company in Lyon.
In a small bakery in Lille.
questions.explanation: “j’ai passé deux ans dans une entreprise de transport à Lille”.

questions.question: How long did he stay there?
questions.explanation: “j’ai passé deux ans”.

questions.question: Why does he want to change jobs?
questions.explanation: “Je cherche un poste avec plus de responsabilités.”

questions.question: What does Thomas have to do first?
choices: Finish a project for his current employer.
questions.explanation: “je dois d’abord finir un projet chez mon employeur actuel”.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Léo, est-ce que l’imprimante du premier étage marche ?
lines.en: Léo, does the printer on the first floor work?

lines.speaker: Léo
lines.fr: Non, elle est en panne depuis hier. J’ai appelé le technicien.
lines.en: No, it's been out of order since yesterday. I called the technician.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Il vient quand ?
lines.en: When is he coming?

lines.speaker: Léo
lines.fr: Demain matin. En attendant, utilise l’imprimante de la comptabilité.
lines.en: Tomorrow morning. In the meantime, use the printer in the accounts department.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: D’accord. Je dois imprimer cinquante pages avant la réunion de quinze heures.
lines.en: Okay. I have to print fifty pages before the 3 p.m. meeting.

questions.question: What is wrong with the printer on the first floor?
choices: It has been out of order since yesterday.
It has run out of paper.
It has been moved to the accounts department.
questions.explanation: “elle est en panne depuis hier”.

questions.question: When is the technician coming?
questions.explanation: “Demain matin.”

questions.question: What does Léo tell Sofia to do meanwhile?
choices: Use the printer in the accounts department.
questions.explanation: “En attendant, utilise l’imprimante de la comptabilité.”

questions.question: What does Sofia have to do before 3 p.m.?
questions.explanation: “Je dois imprimer cinquante pages avant la réunion de quinze heures.”

lines.fr: Bonjour à toute l’équipe.
lines.en: Hello, everyone.

lines.fr: La réunion de jeudi est déplacée à mercredi quatorze heures, salle deux.
lines.en: Thursday's meeting has been moved to Wednesday at two p.m., room two.

lines.fr: Merci de lire le rapport avant la réunion et de préparer vos questions.
lines.en: Please read the report before the meeting and prepare your questions.

lines.fr: Si vous êtes en télétravail, vous pouvez appeler.
lines.en: If you are working from home, you can call in.

lines.fr: Bonne journée à tous. Claire.
lines.en: Have a good day, everyone. Claire.

questions.question: When is the meeting now?
questions.explanation: “La réunion de jeudi est déplacée à mercredi quatorze heures”.

questions.question: What are people asked to do before the meeting?
choices: Read the report and prepare questions.
questions.explanation: “Merci de lire le rapport avant la réunion et de préparer vos questions.”

questions.question: What can people working from home do?
questions.explanation: “Si vous êtes en télétravail, vous pouvez appeler.”

questions.question: Which room is it in?
questions.explanation: “salle deux”.

lines.fr: L’ascenseur est en panne jusqu’à vendredi.
lines.en: The lift is out of order until Friday.

lines.fr: Prenez l’escalier B pour monter au troisième étage.
lines.en: Take staircase B to go up to the third floor.

lines.fr: Les réunions du matin ont lieu au rez-de-chaussée cette semaine.
lines.en: This week the morning meetings take place on the ground floor.

lines.fr: En cas de problème, appelez le gardien.
lines.en: If there is a problem, call the caretaker.

questions.question: How long will the lift stay out of order?
choices: Until the end of the month.
questions.explanation: “L’ascenseur est en panne jusqu’à vendredi.”

questions.question: How do you reach the third floor?
choices: By the stairs at the back.
questions.explanation: “Prenez l’escalier B pour monter au troisième étage.”

questions.question: Where are the morning meetings this week?
questions.explanation: “Les réunions du matin ont lieu au rez-de-chaussée cette semaine.”

questions.question: Who should you call if there is a problem?
questions.explanation: “appelez le gardien”.

lines.fr: Les examens de fin d’année commencent le lundi treize juin.
lines.en: The end-of-year exams start on Monday the thirteenth of June.

lines.fr: L’examen de grammaire a lieu le matin et l’examen d’histoire l’après-midi.
lines.en: The grammar exam takes place in the morning and the history exam in the afternoon.

lines.fr: Les étudiants doivent arriver vingt minutes avant le début.
lines.en: Students must arrive twenty minutes before the start.

lines.fr: Les résultats seront sur le site de l’université la semaine suivante.
lines.en: The results will be on the university website the following week.

questions.question: When do the exams start?
questions.explanation: “commencent le lundi treize juin”.

questions.question: Which exam is in the afternoon?
questions.explanation: “l’examen d’histoire l’après-midi”.

questions.question: How early must students arrive?
choices: Half an hour before the start.
questions.explanation: “arriver vingt minutes avant le début”.

questions.question: Where will the results be?
choices: In an email to each student.
questions.explanation: “Les résultats seront sur le site de l’université”.

lines.fr: Hier, c’était mon premier jour au bureau.
lines.en: Yesterday was my first day at the office.

lines.fr: Je suis arrivée à huit heures et demie, mais il n’y avait encore personne.
lines.en: I arrived at half past eight, but there was still nobody there.

lines.fr: Ma responsable m’a présenté l’équipe vers neuf heures.
lines.en: My manager introduced the team to me at about nine.

lines.fr: L’après-midi, j’ai lu des documents et j’ai créé mon mot de passe.
lines.en: In the afternoon, I read documents and created my password.

lines.fr: Le soir, j’étais fatiguée, mais très contente.
lines.en: In the evening I was tired, but very pleased.

questions.question: What time did she get to the office?
questions.explanation: “Je suis arrivée à huit heures et demie”.

questions.question: What did she find when she arrived?
choices: Her manager was waiting for her.
The whole team was waiting for her.
questions.explanation: “il n’y avait encore personne”.

questions.question: What did she do in the afternoon?
choices: She read documents and set up her password.
She was given a training course.
questions.explanation: “j’ai lu des documents et j’ai créé mon mot de passe”.

questions.question: How did she feel that evening?
questions.explanation: “j’étais fatiguée, mais très contente”.

lines.fr: Salut Nadia, je suis encore à la gare : mon train a une heure de retard.
lines.en: Hi Nadia, I'm still at the station: my train is an hour late.

lines.fr: Je ne pourrai pas venir à la réunion de dix heures.
lines.en: I won't be able to come to the ten o'clock meeting.

lines.fr: Peux-tu lire mon rapport à ma place ?
lines.en: Can you read my report in my place?

lines.fr: Je t’appelle dès que j’arrive au bureau.
lines.en: I'll call you as soon as I get to the office.

lines.fr: Désolé pour ce matin, et bonne réunion !
lines.en: Sorry about this morning, and have a good meeting!

questions.question: Why can't he come to the meeting?
choices: His train is an hour late.
questions.explanation: “mon train a une heure de retard”.

questions.question: What does he ask Nadia to do?
questions.explanation: “Peux-tu lire mon rapport à ma place ?”

questions.question: When will he call her?
choices: As soon as he gets to the office.
questions.explanation: “Je t’appelle dès que j’arrive au bureau.”

questions.question: What time is the meeting?
questions.explanation: “la réunion de dix heures”.

gloss.en: in my place; instead of me
